title: Even-zero sum reduces to odd terms
statement:
Let $a$ be a real sequence such that $a_{2j}=0$ for every nonnegative integer $j$, and let $m$ be a nonnegative integer. Then
\[\sum_{k=0}^{2m+1}a_k=\sum_{j=0}^{m}a_{2j+1}.\]
